spans.s:
m. (-रः)
A tiger.
E.
हिं imitative sound, and कार who makes.

mn. (-ङ्गुः-ङ्गु)
Asafoetida.
E.
हि to go, deriv. irr., or हिम frost, गम to go, डु aff., form irr.

m. (-सः)
1 The Nimb tree.
2 Asafoetida, (the gum.)
E.
हिङ्गु asafoetida, and निर्य्यास exudation.

f. (-ची)
A leaf, and drug, perhaps the leaf of the asafoetida plant.
E.
हिङ्गु asafoetida, and पत्र a leaf.

f. (-र्णी)
A plant, commonly Banspatri.
E.
हिङ्गु asafoetida, and पर्ण leaf.

m. (-लः)
Vermilion.
f. (-ली)
The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena).
E.
हिङ्गु asafoetida, स्ना to take or give, aff. क.

n. (-लं)
An esculent root, a sort of yam.

m. (-लिः)
Vermilion.
E.
हिङ्गु asafœtida, स्ना to take or give, aff. कि.

f. (-का)
A prickly night-shade, (Solanum Jacquini.)
E.
हिङ्गुली the egg-plant, कन् added.

mn. (-लुः-लु)
Vermilion.
E.
हिङ्गु asafœtida, स्ना to give or take, aff. डु.
